figurative_meaning_en: To allow unrestricted or free behavior
example_sentences_in_bangla: সন্তানদের রাশ আলগা করলে তারা অনিয়ম করতে পারে।
প্রশাসকের রাশ আলগা করা কর্মীদের উৎপাত বাড়িয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Giving children free rein can lead to mischief.
The manager's decision to let employees off the leash increased disruptions.
history: This idiom originates from rural practices of loosening ropes on animals to allow them to graze freely, symbolizing a release from control.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Bengali agrarian life where ropes were used to tether livestock.
